notes.title: 🎮 UPDATE 1: NEW WAYS TO PLAY - OUT NOW! 🎮
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/3781fd376de5d63e9c67af4cff8c748944a5f51e.png"]

🌱 Dear Sproutlings 🌱  

It's been a hot minute since we announced this update - but now its finally ready to go.

Heres what we added to Space Sprouts today:


🎮 Controller Support! 
You can now enjoy Space Sprouts with your favourite controller. This was a bit harder than you might think (Unity UI cough). We did quite a lot of testing to make throwing things around as satisfying as possible. And we're really happy that now you can just sit back and mess around with all the weird things in our game with a controller - it just feels nice. And of course you can always re-map everything in the settings menu!


💨Steam Deck Optimization! 
You can now play Space Sprouts on the go with your Steam Deck. It took us quite a bit of time (and help from our most favourite tech wizard) to optimize it for the Deck. We're really happy with its performance now and seeing our game running on that pretty OLED screen really made us smile. If you've got a Steam Deck give it a spin. 

There are of course limits to what the little machine can handle in terms of item duplication and black hole shenanigans - so experiment at your own risk. If you run into any problems let us know on our Discord. And if it runs fine, let Steam know - so we might get that prestigious "Verified" badge some time in the future.


🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese Localization! 
With the help of two lovely people from the Space Sprouts community the game now has an official Simplified Chinese translation. As a tiny team we are so grateful to see people actively helping us to make Space Sprouts accessible to more players around the world. Thanks so much TE-Eh & Butterfly, you're rad!


🧠 3 New Memories! 
We also added three new memories to discover on your big ol' space ship. Might they be connected to this update? Take another flight, poke around and find it out yourself! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/eacc247110f3e468d6dc3617daa1aac731cd0293.png"]

Thats it for the first update. The second update SECRETS & MEMORIES is in the works and is coming as soon as possible.



Cheers & thanks for playing!

- The Schleuder Gäng  



⭐💚 And don’t forget to leave a review for Space Sprouts, it helps us more than you might think 💚⭐

notes.title: ⭐ STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO! FINAL TOUCHES BEFORE RELEASE!⭐
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b803455512cd32146b0bd725bc9a4c4461f5f77b.png

🚀 Final Touches Before Launch!

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

We’re in the final stretch of development, and Space Sprouts is getting its last big improvements before release! Every room in the ship is receiving a visual makeover and recoloring, bringing a fresh coat of paint to the entire world. But that’s not all—we’ve also added new memories, edge cases, and hidden Easter eggs for players to discover. Keep your eyes open! 👀

🖥️ Revamped UI: Result Screens, Memories & Map
We’ve made major improvements or fully rebuilt some of the game’s UI to enhance the experience:
- New animated result screens 🎉 – After each run, you’ll now see what you discovered in even cooler ways.
- Improved Memory UI & popups 🧠 – Track new discoveries, recalled memories, and reconstructed ones more easily.
- New Map UI 🗺️ – Get a clearer overview of where you’ve been and where to go next.
- Quality-of-life improvements ✨ – Features like pinning memories allow for better run planning and tracking.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/f3294ce1445754529801f2ce289fa64fa1aa80b9.jpg

🎨 Improved Room Colors
We updated all room colors to give each room its own distinct identity. Both for better orientation and because it just looks nicer. We had this on our to-do-list since forever and now we finally had the time.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/776edc6c4c99d454b4e46c0eb987af5ce1c7b026.png

✨ All New Key Art
The more defined Space Sprouts got over time the more we needed new key art that represents the game better. While the old key art is dear to our hearts (it accompanied us on many conventions last year) we are so happy to reveal this all new detailed illustration of Oda being maybe a bit too curious. We hope you like it as much as we do!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/158ad0399ca29c5705d0fbd744eff620ce0a90b7.png

🎮 Steam Next Fest – Big Demo Update!
To celebrate these updates, we’ve wrapped the current state of the game into a big demo update for Steam Next Fest! This version showcases some of the new content, so don’t miss it!

💥Most chaotic screenshot contest!
To celebrate our participation at Steam Next Fest with a new demo, we're running a contest on our Discord! Send us your most chaotic screenshot of the new Space Sprouts demo during the duration of the festival for a chance to win a pack of stickers, a hand-drawn illustration and a copy of the game!

🌍 Localization – Want to Help?
Last but not least, we’re currently translating the game into multiple languages! If you’re a native speaker in a language other than English and want to contribute, let us know—we’d love your support! Leave a comment below or join us on Discord!

Love, Peace & Video Games forever! 💖
⭐ Space Sprouts is launching on March 31st! Don’t forget to wishlist Space Sprouts on Steam to get notified at launch!! ⭐

notes.title: ⭐ RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! MARCH 31st! ⭐
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d7eaf70d6fba6aab9a887780f7a5f3ed22a76c00.png

💫BREAKING NEWS! March 31st!
The official release date for Space Sprouts! 🥳🚀 

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

we are very excited to finally announce the release date of Space Sprouts in exactly 2 months from today, on the last day of March!

After more than 2 years of hard work we cannot wait to bring our first game out into the world!

Next month we will participate in the Steam Next Fest, which runs from Feb. 27th until March 3rd, with a brand new demo including many new areas we have added in the last month!

🛠️ Connecting, Polishing, and Adding Secrets

This month we've been hard at work:

 Connecting areas and filling gaps for smoother exploration 🌌
 Adding secret tunnels for you to discover – who doesn’t love a hidden path? 🔍
 Replacing blockouts with final artwork, making each area come alive. 🎨
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/8d8e23a70fc3672fa748e54c66b7d96db8400ef7.png

💎 Powering Up with Gem-Powered Engines!

One of the most exciting additions is the new engine, powered by mysterious gems. Check out the progression from sketch to final design in the images attached! This engine will be the heart of your journey, pushing you further into the cosmos.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b6a3bb9bb3e7701cc85b106b2b879cd57fbf631c.png

⏳ Late Game & Playtesting

As we build out the late-game areas, we’ve dedicated extra time to playtesting the progression. Huge thanks to our dedicated playtesters for helping us refine the experience and make the late-game as thrilling as the first launch! Your support means the world to us. 💚

✨ Here’s a look at how all the areas come together:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/832ef137ed6a8ec91a54bb6cc376ac7c255cb5d2.png

🛸 Join our playtesting sessions!

If you are too impatient to wait until the release of Space Sprouts on March 31st, you can also become a playtester of the almost final version of the game, as we are still running playtesting sessions! You can sign up here!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/c5bf318fbbc5faea4ef7bccda8a50fa55d7be0c9.png

Otherwise you can check out the current demo and join our Discord, there you can also let us know your feedback and hang out with us!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/183067505ac7abe80e2fdf134ae98aaf852380f5.jpg

By the way, this week we reached 1,000 followers on 🦋BlueSky! We're so happy to see this community grow 🩵 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/50fa88cb6029615d299aa4bdd654b937b7efa973.png

Love, Peace & Video Games forever! 💖
⭐ Don’t forget to WISHLIST Space Sprouts on Steam, it really helps us a lot! ⭐

notes.title: NEW DEMO & NEW TRAILER! RELEASE WINDOW ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.notes:
Dear Sproutlings 🌱,
We are very happy to present our brand new trailer to you!

[previewyoutube=wOofT_90OLM;full][/previewyoutube]

A lot of work has gone into crafting the video to really capture what Space Sprouts is all about. Make sure to watch it here on Steam or on our socials and share it with a friend!

Space Sprouts is coming to PC in early 2025, so don't forget to put it on your wishlist!

New Demo! 
Along with today's trailer we also released a new demo version for you to play! We already covered some exciting information about all the changes in last week's newsletter, so here is a run down:

💼 Overhauled tutorial area with new items!
📐 New rooms and room layouts!
✨ Delicious new colors, effects and visuals!
🔥  And the chance to start a fire!

Let's take a closer look:

New Space Simulator Room!
We added a brand new room to get a feeling for your first space walk.

👨‍🚀 Become a real astronaut with your very own space suit!
🌠 Learn to evade asteroids in a zero-G-chamber!
💡 Lots of secrets and hidden mysteries waiting to be discovered!

Updated Room Layouts!
We overhauled the layouts of several rooms for smoother progress and better connections. So even if you played the old demo there are many new things to discover!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/43a72375b97d9fced4ec53b48e2dbd488d37d689.jpg

GWB Game Awards
We are happy to be finalists of the GWB Game Awards that will be held today on Steam at around 5:30 pm. MEZ!!
You can find the Steam Event here: GWB Game Awards Steam Event

Indie Arena Booth
Back in August we got to be part of the amazing Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom where we showcased Space Sprouts! Today starts a Recap Steam Event with all the wonderful participants of IAB, so make sure to also check that out: IAB 2024 Recap Steam Event

Thank you for your support so far! Let us know what you think about the trailer and demo and leave some feedback here on Steam or on our socials!

Love, Peace & Video Games forever! <3
